CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.cobra_provision_authorizer()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select coalesce(public.cobra_quality_importer(),false) and exists(select 1 from public.cobra_provision_authority where user_id=(select auth.uid()));
$function$
